notes: «- واللفظ له -» is an editor gloss and is left out.
Branch 1 ends at ابن أبي حمزة as written. The text names الزهري and سالم only in branch 2 and writes no name where the branches meet, so no shared tail is read.
«أبيه» is Salim's father, named only by relation; the saying is his («قال رأيت رسول الله»).
